Product Features

  • Total dimensions: 70 cm x 70 cm x 31.5 cm, with drawer storage of 27 cm x 28.5 cm x 13 cm. Perfect for living rooms, it ensures a neat and tidy space without taking up too much space.
  • Color: White with wood finish, perfect for modern living rooms. It blends easily into various interior styles, including modern, Nordic and Japanese, and creates a natural, fresh atmosphere.
  • Shape: Square top, tidy and suitable for small living rooms and sofa side tables.
  • High Gloss Material: The drawer surfaces and surrounding outer panels are made of a high gloss material for a smoother, easier to maintain surface. There is a protective film on the surface; please remove them after assembly. (The high-gloss finish is limited to the drawer surfaces and outer panels.)
  • Storage: Three drawers are available for frequently used items such as magazines, laptops, and chess sets to expand storage space and keep all your belongings organized.
  • Three floor-supported rails ensure smooth and comfortable drawer operation, increasing the durability of the drawers and coffee table. 7. Each drawer is equipped with a spring that ensures smooth opening and closing.
  • Material and load capacity: The chipboard drawer has a recommended total load capacity of 30 kg. Whether for storing a computer, tea sets or decorative items - it offers a stable hold and does not deform even after prolonged use.
  • The semi-open storage space provides convenient access to frequently used books and magazines, thus meeting both storage and comfort requirements.
  • Each drawer is equipped with a spring that ensures smooth opening and closing.
  • Friendly Note: Due to different shooting conditions and display devices, there may be slight color variations between the actual product and the image. This is normal and does not pose a quality issue. We make every effort to faithfully reproduce the color of the product. Please order with caution if you have any concerns.
